description: Ask Amazon whether it would take the photos, GPSR contacts, texts, safety documents, shipping settings and missing listing data of up to 25 products on their EXISTING Amazon offers — Amazon's own dry run (VALIDATION_PREVIEW), which changes nothing. Per product: status (ready = Amazon would accept; nothing = nothing to send, see skipped; blocked = no offer to write to, see reason: noListing, removedFromChannel, syncPaused, listingNotFound, variationParent; rejected = Amazon refused it, see issues in the marketplace's language; failed = the call failed), the attributes it would send, filled (what the attributes part fills, by key and the store's own title), stillMissing (what this store's product type requires and nobody has answered: set it with set_amazon_field_values, keys and values from get_amazon_fields), untranslated (what the store lacks and the CRM knows only in another language: write it with upsert_product_translation, or set_channel_texts for the title and points) and skipped (noImages, noManufacturer, noResponsiblePerson, noTexts, noDocuments, noShipping; noAttributes = this store already shows everything the CRM could fill; colorFamilyUnknown = the colour's name goes, but which of Amazon's colour families it is cannot be told from it: set color.standardized_values on the product with set_amazon_field_values; the product type does not take that attribute: textsNotInSchema, documentsNotInSchema, templateNotInSchema, handlingNotInSchema; templateNotInStore = the template is not one of this store's; shippingNotMfn = Amazon ships the offer itself; handlingNoQuantity = no tracked stock to carry the handling time). GPSR companies are set on the brand or supplier (assign_economic_operators), Amazon texts with set_amazon_listing_texts, safety documents with set_product_safety_documents, shipping with set_amazon_shipping. Needs a listing marketplace chosen on the Amazon connection; no arming. Then send with update_amazon_listing_content. Use inspect_amazon_listings first to find offers Amazon flags.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store; a send needs it when several stores are open for photos and GPSR.

parts.description: What to send: images (the product's main photo and up to 8 more, replacing Amazon's), gpsr (the manufacturer and the EU responsible person, as the emails of records the seller created in Seller Central — taken from the product's brand, else its supplier), texts (the title and bullet points written for Amazon with set_amazon_listing_texts — nothing is sent when none were written), documents (the product's safety PDFs, set with set_product_safety_documents), shipping (the shipping template and handling time set with set_amazon_shipping; a handling time travels with the quantity, so it needs a merchant-fulfilled product with tracked stock) and attributes (every other fact a new listing would carry on this store in its language: the colour's name with Amazon's colour family, the brand, the manufacturer, material, description, measurements and the values set with set_amazon_field_values; only what this store does not show yet, so a live listing's are never rewritten. An offer carried over from another store has none of them, and Amazon hides it from search until it does). Default: all six; a part with nothing to send is reported in skipped.

productIds.description: The products whose Amazon offers to update, at most 25 ids from search_products or inspect_amazon_listings.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
